C-SAFE-LOCALE-REVIEW.Name: Complete semantic review of generated locale changes
C-SAFE-LOCALE-REVIEW.Summary: Implement the owner-mandated exact-candidate commit/push safety protocol for generated one-line locale JSON: keep full-blob static scans and raw identity binding; send every changed field and value to both serial local-model passes without repeating unchanged generated text.
C-SAFE-LOCALE-REVIEW.ApprovalBasis: Owner approved sequential integration and required secret/path safety with mandatory local-model review and recheck. This is an internal review representation choice within that authorized protocol.

Goals.Goal: Preserve complete changed data while avoiding repeated unchanged locale content in model context.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No reduced scanner coverage, model fallback or new product behavior.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Every semantic change retained; unsupported input uses the raw diff; exact raw candidate is scanned and rechecked.

Constraints.Constraint: No data truncation, secret/path allowlists, review bypass, ignored changed values or reduced static scans. Ambiguous/unsupported diffs retain the raw model view. Raw candidate digest and final recheck remain binding.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Nested additions/removals/replacements, arrays and value types remain visible; duplicates, floats, invalid JSON and unsupported hunk shapes fall back to raw text; added exposure data stays visible and full static scans still reject it.
Gate tests and two serial local reviews pass before installing reviewed hooks and committing/pushing this separate task.

AffectedAreas.Area: M-064/V-M-064 safety gate, its tests, docs and projections.
